jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Help more engineering teams find and adopt cloud mobile development. Limrun gives cloud agents the infrastructure they need to build, run, test, and ship iOS and Android apps. We're hiring an SDR to find the right companies, start informed conversations, and create qualified opportunities for our sales team.


**Why Limrun**
--------------



Limrun is building a new category, so the SDR work goes beyond running a fixed sequence against a purchased list. You'll work directly with the founder and early GTM team to decide which accounts matter, learn what earns a response from technical buyers, and turn those lessons into a repeatable outbound motion.



Limrun is already in production at platforms like Replit, Rork, Minitap, Momentic. We are backed by investors including CRV, Y Combinator, and Eniac Ventures.



As an early sales hire, your work will be visible in the pipeline and the product conversations that follow. There is room to take on broader sales responsibility as you learn the product and show consistent judgment.


**The role**
------------



You'll own the top of the funnel. That means researching accounts and contacts, reaching out with relevant messages, qualifying initial interest, and arranging meetings with enough context for an Account Executive or founder to take the opportunity forward. The quality of the handoff matters more than raw activity.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Build target\-account lists across AI app\-building platforms, mobile engineering organizations adopting cloud agents, internal developer\-platform teams, and testing or QA companies.
* Find the people closest to the problem, including engineering executives, developer\-experience and platform leaders, mobile engineering leaders, and senior technical champions.
* Research each account and write outreach based on its mobile products, agent initiatives, infrastructure needs, and likely buying triggers.
* Run outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone, warm introductions, and other channels that you test and measure.
* Respond quickly to inbound interest and qualify the use case, urgency, technical context, stakeholders, and next step.
* Book qualified meetings and give the Account Executive or founder a clear handoff: who is involved, what problem they are trying to solve, why it matters now, and what was agreed.
* Keep Salesforce accurate and maintain disciplined follow\-up. Document outreach experiments, account progress, and results so the team can learn from them.
* Learn Limrun well enough to explain the product accurately to technical buyers and avoid promising capabilities that are not available.

**How you'll use AI and automation**
------------------------------------



You'll help build the workflows behind the outbound work as well as run them. Use AI and practical automation to improve research, data quality, and follow\-up, with human review of the facts and messages.


* Build repeatable account\-research and contact\-enrichment workflows. Check information across sources, remove duplicates, and verify contact details before outreach.
* Monitor public buying signals such as relevant hiring, team changes, developer discussions, and product announcements. Record the source and explain why the signal makes an account worth contacting now.
* Write and test targeted outreach sequences, and set up the workflows that keep follow\-up timely. Adjust them based on replies and prospect activity; check AI\-generated claims and personalization before sending.
* Work with the founder and engineering team on email\-delivery checks and small messaging or landing\-page experiments. Use approved tools and respect opt\-outs and platform rules.
* Connect outreach sources and experiments to qualified meetings and opportunities in Salesforce. Use results and patterns in won customers to improve account selection, rather than judging success by send volume alone.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* You've personally created pipeline through outbound prospecting, ideally for an early\-stage technology company or a product that did not have an established brand.
* You can write short, specific outreach and speak confidently with technical prospects.
* You are curious enough to learn a developer product, understand a prospect's workflow, and ask useful follow\-up questions.
* You take ownership, ask for feedback, and are willing to do hands\-on research, prospecting, calling, and follow\-up every day.
* You are organized about CRM records, next steps, and follow\-through.
* You care about qualified meetings and real buying signals, not activity counts that do not turn into opportunities.


We care more about what you personally tried, learned, and produced than about titles or years of experience.


**Nice to have, not required**
------------------------------


* Experience selling developer tools, cloud infrastructure, AI development products, or another technical product.
* Experience prospecting to CTOs, engineering leaders, developer\-experience teams, platform teams, or mobile engineering organizations.
* Experience working in a startup where pipeline had to be created without a large marketing team.
* Familiarity with Salesforce and modern account\-research or outbound tools.

**What we offer**
-----------------


* Ownership of the outbound and qualification process at an early stage.
* Direct collaboration with the founder, the early GTM team, and the engineers building the product.
* A San Francisco office in South Park, with relocation support.
* Regular team offsites.

**Apply**
---------



Send us your resume or LinkedIn profile. In 4\-6 sentences, describe one outbound campaign or prospecting motion you personally ran. How did you choose the accounts, which channels and messages did you use, how did you qualify interest, and what was the outcome? Please do not include confidential customer information.

**We are seeking an organized, proactive Compliance Program Coordinator** to help manage and maintain our legal, regulatory, licensing, and operational obligations.

You will directly prepare and submit compliance filings, registrations, renewals, reports, and other required documentation. guidance or support is needed.

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

**Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** We are seeking a French\-speaking Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join the Immigrant Health \& Cancer Disparities team.

  

  

This role supports Health Fairs through the Taxi Network Initiative. This team conducts community\-based participatory research to reduce health disparities and investigate varying health concerns among NYC taxi drivers. The CRCs assist with the maintenance of participant management and data management on research/clinical studies.

  

  

**Role Overview:**

* Lead participant recruitment and outreach by attending health fairs at taxi garages, conducting interviews, and guiding individuals through the study enrollment and consent process
* Assist the study RN with finger sticks and enter participant data accurately into the system
* Support data collection using appropriate methodologies to gather human subject information for research protocols and/or clinical trials, including assisting with patient recruitment and maintaining study databases within specified timelines
* Generate and distribute data reports to key stakeholders on study progress
* Ensure compliance with all applicable institutional, state, and federal regulations; maintain IRB approvals and complete required regulatory documentation
* Provide clerical and administrative support, including filing, organizing study materials, and participating in study meetings as needed
  

  

**Key Qualifications:**

* Fluency in written and spoken French is required (a language assessment will be part of the interview process)
* A genuine interest in working in health disparities research
* Experience in the healthcare setting or a community engagement role is preferred
* Experience using data entry tools like REDCap is a plus
  

  

**Core Skills:**

* **Interpersonal skills:** Strong ability to build rapport and communicate effectively with individuals who may be unfamiliar with research participation.
* **Decision\-making:** Demonstrated success in making timely, effective decisions that support organizational progress.
* **Accountability:** Strong sense of personal responsibility, with the ability to hold yourself and others accountable to achieve results.
* **Adaptability:** Flexible in approach and demeanor, able to adjust to shifting priorities and evolving circumstances.
* **Data proficiency:** Comfortable working with or eager to learn how to manage and organize large amounts of data.
  

  

**Additional Information:**

* **Hours:** Most days are Monday \- Friday, 9 am \- 5 pm (hybrid schedule, 4 days onsite/week, up to 5 days depending on need). **Flexibility is required to work evening shifts approximately 4 days per month from 12 pm \- 8 pm, and 1 Sunday per month from 12 pm \- 8 pm.**

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Hawksmoor is a British steakhouse group, currently ranked No. 2 in the world among multi\-site steakhouse groups by the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants awards. We have three restaurants in the US: New York, Boston and Chicago, and this role owns the organic social media strategy across all of them, working alongside our Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead.


Our growth in the US rests on the same obsession that built the brand in the UK: real sourcing, real cooking, and a genuine point of view, carried through everything from the menu to the media we put out. This role is responsible for turning that into a considered, confident organic social strategy that builds Hawksmoor's reputation across three major US markets, and then for executing it hands\-on, building the strategy and creating the content that brings it to life, in close partnership with our UK\-based brand marketing team.


Key Responsibilities:

*Strategy \& Planning*

* Collaborate with the Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead to develop and present the U.S. organic social media strategy in line with Hawksmoor’s business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Create and maintain monthly and quarterly social media plans for U.S. restaurants, aligned with wider business activity and culturally relevant moments.
* Act as the primary lead for Hawksmoor’s social media presence in the U.S., while working closely with the broader marketing team to ensure consistency of tone and brand messaging across regions.
* Build and present the US organic social strategy with the Group Senior Content Manager, tying every plan back to Hawksmoor's business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Turn brand plans and business goals into monthly and quarterly social plans for all three US restaurants, timed to wider business activity and moments that actually matter to our audience.
* Own the US social presence day to day, working with the wider marketing team to keep tone and message consistent across the UK and US.

*Content \& Scheduling*

* Manage day\-to\-day channel activity, including community management, across all platforms for the US market
* Ensure cohesion between social media activity and wider marketing channels
* Proactively introduce creative social campaigns tied to brand activity, business objectives and cultural moments
* Brief and collaborate with internal teams and external partners as required
* Educate and upskill the wider marketing team on social media trends and platform best practice
* Know which content works on which platform for which audience, and plan accordingly rather than posting the same thing everywhere.
* Plan and schedule daily activity so campaigns land on time and stay relevant.

*Community \& Engagement*

* Build genuine community, not just reply to comments and DMs on time, though that matters too. The goal is people who follow because they feel part of something.
* Build relationships with local influencers, creators and partners who fit the brand, to extend reach in each city.
* Spot opportunities for co\-creation, user\-generated content and local partnerships.

*Insights \& Performance*

* Track performance and use the data to sharpen content, not just to report on it.
* Report regularly on activity and results, and use what you learn to adjust strategy.
* Stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes, and know what's worth acting on versus what's just noise.


Requirements:

* 3–5 years' proven experience managing social media across multiple channels and content types, ideally in hospitality, food \& beverage, lifestyle or another premium, consumer\-facing brand.
* Hands\-on, proven experience managing Facebook, Instagram, TikTok end\-to\-end with a track record of managing high\-volume channels with large followings.
* A track record of turning brand plans and business objectives into organic social strategy that actually delivers.
* Real platform and audience expertise: you know what content works on which platform for which audience
* Exceptional attention to detail, the kind that shows up in every caption, crop and post time.
* A quality\-first instinct rather than a trend\-chasing one. Our guest is 35\+ and discerning; we want someone who can build content with real craft and restraint, not something that only works because it's this week's trend.
* Experience building community and engagement, not just managing it. Growing genuine audience connection rather than just responding to comments and messages.
* Sharp instincts for algorithm shifts, platform changes and emerging opportunities, and the initiative to act on them early.
* Content / asset creation skills a bonus but not necessity (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with real command of tone and brand voice.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities, which is normal in hospitality, and able to reprioritize without losing quality.
* Highly organized, confident managing your own timeline across time zones with the UK team.
* Pride in the work: every post represents the whole restaurant, and you treat it that way.
* Willingness to travel semi\-regularly between New York, Boston and Chicago.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


Givebutter is the most\-loved nonprofit fundraising and CRM platform, empowering millions of changemakers to raise more, pay less, and give better. Nonprofits use Givebutter to replace multiple tools so they can launch fundraisers and events, use donation forms and donor management (CRM), send emails and text blasts—all in one place. Use of the Givebutter platform is completely free with a 100% transparent tip\-or\-fee model.


Givebutter has been certified as a Great Place to Work every year since 2021, and is the \#1 rated nonprofit software company on G2 across multiple categories.


Our mission is to empower the changemaker in all of us. We believe giving should be fun, so you’ll want to do it again, and we also believe that work should be fun, so that you’ll have the greatest impact. We are excited to hear from talented people who want to work with other talented people in making the world a butter place—and have fun along the way.

**Role Description**
--------------------


The Sales Development Representative, Outbound, is responsible for generating net\-new pipeline by proactively identifying, researching, and prospecting into nonprofit organizations that could benefit from Givebutter. This role is for someone who thrives on the challenge of building conversations from scratch: through cold calls, personalized emails, and social outreach, and has the energy and resilience to consistently fill the top of the funnel. Success here requires a drive to exceed activity targets, a hunter mentality, and a genuine belief in the mission of the nonprofits we serve.

**We want to hear from people who…**

* Are a self starter and motivated to succeed in a fast paced environment
* A team player with a positive winning attitude
* Critical thinking skills and the ability to adapt quickly
* An empathetic mind\-set with a customer first mentality

**Responsibilities**

* Research nonprofit organizations and build targeted lists of prospects using LinkedIn, HubSpot, and other tools.
* Reach out to prospective customers through cold calls, personalized emails, and social channels to generate interest in Givebutter.
* Lead discovery conversations to assess fit and timing, then book qualified meetings for Account Executives.
* Meet or exceed weekly and monthly goals for calls, outreach, and qualified meetings.
* Keep HubSpot records accurate and current, including outreach activity, conversation notes, prospect status, and pipeline progress.
* Use performance data and feedback to improve outreach messaging, sequences, and targeting.
* Stay informed about Givebutter’s products, customer stories, and nonprofit fundraising trends to make outreach relevant and helpful.

**Requirements**

* 2\+ years of prior outbound sales or SDR experience; cold calling and multi\-channel prospecting experience is required
* Demonstrated ability to hit or exceed activity and pipeline targets in a high\-volume, self\-directed environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, personalized cold outreach
* Resilient and self\-motivated; comfortable with rejection and energized by the challenge of building a pipeline from scratch
* Experience with CRM software (HubSpot preferred) and familiarity with outbound prospecting or sequencing tools
* Passion for social impact, nonprofits, or tech for good

**More about Givebutter**
-------------------------

* **Remote Work:** Work remotely from one of our 10 hubs (Austin, Denver, Indianapolis, Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Salt Lake City, Minneapolis, Seattle, and Nashville).

* **Vacation and Holidays:** Givebutter offers a Flexible PTO policy with uncapped vacation days and company\-recognized holidays.

* **Home Office Stipend:** Upgrade your home office with company\-sponsored expenses, including high\-quality laptops, monitors, and modern technology.
* **Coworking Stipend:** Enjoy a monthly stipend that gives you the freedom to work from coworking spaces or cafés whenever you need connection, community, or a change of scenery.
* **Charitable Giving:** Employees are encouraged to donate up to $50/month to any verified nonprofit they wish to support on Givebutter.
* **Professional Development:** We offer learning and development reimbursement opportunities.
* **Love What You Do:** We are a mission\-driven company serving the charitable sector. Feel good about the work you're doing and the company you work for.

### **PEAK6**


**New York, New York, United States of America**

We are PEAK6, a leading investment firm, using technology to find a better way of doing things. The company’s first tech\-based solution was developed in 1997 to optimize options trading, and over the past two decades, the same formula has been used across a range of industries, asset classes, and business stages to consistently deliver superior results. jobs.title: Chiropractic Office Manager & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Chiropractic Office Manager \& Marketing Coordinator to lead our healthcare practice with enthusiasm and precision. This pivotal role combines the responsibilities of managing daily office operations, overseeing staff, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and driving innovative marketing strategies to grow our patient community. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast\-paced environment, possess a passion for healthcare excellence, and demonstrate exceptional managerial and communication skills. Join us to make a meaningful impact on patient care while fostering a vibrant, efficient practice environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee all aspects of clinic management, including scheduling, patient flow, medical records, billing, and compliance with HIPAA and other health regulation policies
* Lead and supervise administrative staff, ensuring high standards of customer service and operational efficiency
* Manage financial aspects such as budgeting, medical billing, fiscal management, and practice profitability
* Utilize EMR (Electronic Medical Records), EHR (Electronic Health Records), and patient management software like Eaglesoft and Dentrix to maintain accurate medical documentation and streamline workflows
* Coordinate marketing initiatives to enhance community outreach, patient engagement, and practice growth through digital campaigns, social media, and local outreach efforts
* Ensure adherence to healthcare practice management standards including JCAHO accreditation requirements and utilization management protocols
* Supervise human resources functions such as hiring, training, performance evaluations, and staff development in a healthcare setting
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of health regulation policies and ensure practice compliance with all legal standards including managed care policies
* Support medical administrative functions by managing medical records, coding accuracy, medical billing processes, and insurance claims processing
* Foster a positive team environment by managing healthcare staff effectively across clinic operations while promoting excellent customer service

**Experience**

* Proven experience in medical office management within chiropractic or similar healthcare settings; dental clinic experience is a plus
* Demonstrated supervisory experience managing teams in a healthcare environment with strong leadership skills
* Extensive knowledge of EMR/EHR systems such as Eaglesoft or Dentrix; proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is essential
* Familiarity with healthcare regulations including HIPAA compliance, JCAHO standards, managed care policies, and health regulation policy knowledge
* Background in fiscal management including budgeting, financial reporting, medical billing, and revenue cycle management
* Prior experience with healthcare practice management software and patient management systems is required
* Strong understanding of medical terminology, medical records management, and clinical workflows in acute care or hospital settings is highly desirable
* Excellent managerial communication skills combined with customer service expertise to foster team collaboration and patient satisfaction

Join us to lead an energetic team dedicated to delivering exceptional chiropractic care while expanding our community reach through innovative marketing strategies. We value your expertise in healthcare management combined with your passion for creating an efficient, compliant, and welcoming practice environment.

Pay: $17\.25 \- $22\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lawrenceville, GA 30043

jobs.title: Real Estate Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join our innovative team at Virtual Properties Realty as a Real Estate Marketing Coordinator, where you'll elevate your career and creativity. You'll be at the forefront of our marketing efforts, crafting visually stunning materials and managing engaging social media campaigns that resonate with our audience. We value your creative vision and technical prowess, particularly your proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, and your knack for WordPress website management. Together, we'll brainstorm fresh ideas and ensure brand consistency across all platforms.  

  

You'll thrive in our collaborative environment, working closely with leadership, agents, and vendors. Your strong communication skills and ability to manage multiple projects will be key as you bring fresh marketing ideas to life and keep everything on track. In return, we offer a competitive compensation package and a supportive culture that values work/life balance, diversity, and professional development. Let's grow together—apply today to be a part of our dynamic team!

 **Compensation:**
$45,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:****What You’ll Do**

* **Graphic Design \& Branding** – Design print and digital marketing materials, flyers, listing presentations, and event promotions that reflect our brokerage’s brand.
* **Website Management** – Maintain and update our **WordPress** website with fresh content, blog posts, and new property listings; optimize for SEO and user experience.
* **Social Media Marketing** – Create and schedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other platforms to drive brand awareness and agent engagement.
* **Email \& Campaign Management** – Design and send email newsletters, promotional campaigns, and agent communications.
* **Creative Strategy \& Vision** – Work with leadership to develop marketing campaigns that grow brand recognition and recruit top talent.
* **Event Marketing Support** – Assist with marketing materials for open houses, training events, and community outreach.
* **Reporting \& Analytics** – Track engagement, provide insights, and recommend ways to improve marketing performance.
  

**Qualifications:*** Experience in graphic design, with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or Canva.
* Ability to manage and update WordPress websites, ensuring SEO optimization and user\-friendly navigation.
* Proven track record of creating engaging social media content across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Strong skills in email marketing, including designing newsletters and managing promotional campaigns.
* Ability to collaborate with leadership to develop innovative marketing strategies that enhance brand recognition.
* Experience in supporting event marketing efforts, including creating materials for open houses and community events.
* Proficiency in analyzing marketing data and providing actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  

**About Company**  

Virtual Properties Realty is an innovative, motivating, and educational top\-notch Real Estate Firm. The firm holds over 5500 licenses for some of the best agents in the industry, which makes Virtual Properties Realty top\-notch! We not only hold an agent’s license in our company, but we also make sure that their licenses are up to standard and that they stay that way. We are a family\-based company with a commitment to our staff to have a great work/life balance. We are looking for passionate, hard\-working people who want to be a part of a winning team that takes ownership and pride in what they do. Our headquarters is in Duluth; however, we have 14 offices throughout Metro Atlanta. We offer health/dental/vision benefits, 401(k), PTO, and sick leave. Applicants must complete a background check and drug test.

jobs.description:

Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point\-of\-care electroencephalography ("EEG") platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. Our entire team is driven by a shared commitment to transforming the landscape of critical care through our rapid seizure detection technology, come join the movement!


The Strategic Account Manager plays a critical role in driving Ceribell's growth across key regional IDNs, academic medical centers, and large health systems. This individual contributor position focuses on securing system\-wide adoption and expanding utilization of Ceribell's rapid EEG technology across multiple care settings.

* Fantastic culture with tremendous career advancement opportunities

jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Account Manager – US Hub**



Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?



The Inside Sales Account Manager (ISAM) is the primary sales representative responsible for the achievement of sales objectives and growth targets for our mid market and small medium enterprise customers. Territory includes exciting opportunities to grow smaller existing customers and establish new customers.



As an Inside Sales Account Manager dedicated to Siemens Digital Industries, you will work closely with our business to business customers, leveraging our field sales and distribution partners, to provide innovative and environmentally friendly solutions through our digital channels. You play an important part contributing to overall customer happiness and achieving annual sales growth aspirations.


**We are looking for an Inside Sales Account Manager. This position will have hybrid remote capability and will be based in Alpharetta, GA.**


***You’ll make an impact by:***


* Virtual selling is not just a buzzword for you: You target a balanced blend of engagement (e.g. Digital selling, virtual communication) with customers via digital enabled actions to ensure outstanding customer experience.
* Understanding customer needs and guiding decision making towards Siemens Solutions through compelling storytelling today and tomorrow.
* You have a passion for technology, products, and services within the area of industrial automation, and digitalization, understanding their value and the ability to help customers get the most out of our portfolio. (e.g., HMI, SINAMICS, SIMATIC).
* Thanks to your reliable consulting and proactive nature, you represent yourself at eye level for your customers and show the ability and confidence to work through tough situations if they arise.
* Personally, you capitalize with excellent listening skills and an honest, open communication style which generates excitement over the phone or in video calls.
* Ensure positive customer experiences by embracing a vast Siemens Ecosystem including: Field Sales, Product Marketing, the Distributor Sales Team etc. Success in this role will include collaborating with and leveraging partnership with US distribution channels and external industry associations/partner organizations.
* Use various tools (e.g., Salesforce CRM and Outreach) to manage, monitor and track opportunities on a timely basis, as well as document \& research customer information.
* Achieve and exceed personal sales targets.
* Find incremental business opportunities and drive closure within the targeted prospect and customer account base.


**You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:**



Basic Qualifications:


* 5\+ years of relevant professional experience
* 2\+ years of experience selling to business to business customers
* Sales training, including handling.
* Must have firsthand training and/or experience with CRM systems.
* Ability to generate prospective customers via warm and cold calling as assigned, as well as determined focus on follow up with decision makers and forward movement throughout the sales cycle.
* Ability to understand and interpret technical requirements for specific solutions being sold.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.


Preferred Qualifications:


* Bachelor’s Degree or equal professional work experience.
* Industrial background in Technology sales
* Prior experience using Salesforce as a CRM

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. jobs.title: Personal Lines Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** The **Personal Lines Insurance Account Manager** will be responsible for managing a book of insurance business, marketing new and renewal business, and rounding out client accounts. In addition to client relationships, an Account Manager also maintains positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None


**Essential Tasks:**


* Assisting the Personal Lines Sales Producer in maintaining the client's insurance policies
* Preparing endorsements to send to the insurance carriers
* Assisting with cancellations of policies
* Educates clients about coverages and make recommendations as needed to meet client insurance needs
* Handles renewals and remarkets as needed. Develop proposals and may present to clients.
* Handles or refers insured’s questions or delegates to appropriate team member
* Actively refers clients to Benefits and Commercial Lines departments for solicitation of new business
* Maintains detailed customer records in the agency management systems (Applied EPIC and CSR 24\)
* Maintains healthy working relationship with underwriters, carriers and other stakeholders
* On occasion, may work with Accounting Department to reconcile accounting discrepancies
* Keeps informed regarding industry information, new product information, coverages, and technology to continuously improve knowledge and stay current


**Core Competencies:**

* Ability to Analyze and Solve Problems: Skill in recognizing challenges, exploring options, and implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
* Attention to Detail: A strong focus on completing tasks and projects accurately and thoroughly
* Communication Skills: Capable of expressing ideas clearly in both verbal and written forms and engaging with various audiences
* Timely Task Completion: Ability to finish tasks and projects efficiently, managing resources and priorities effectively
* Team Collaboration: Willingness to work together with others, promoting teamwork and supporting shared goals
* Client Focus: Dedication to understanding and addressing the needs of clients and stakeholders to ensure their satisfaction
* Dependability: Acknowledgment of the importance of being present and punctual.
* Creative Thinking: Openness to suggesting new ideas and methods to improve processes and outcome
* Organizational Skills: Capability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Adaptability: Willingness to adjust to changing situations and priorities, showing resilience in a dynamic work environment


**Experience and Education:**


* 3\-5 years of Personal Line Insurance experience required
* Experience with high net worth clients is a plus


**Licensing and Credentials:**


* Active General Lines or Property \& Casualty License required
* Designations preferred (i.e CISR, CIC, CPRIA)


**Systems:**


* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Applied Epic experience preferred, but knowledge of similar Account Management System (AMS) is acceptable


**Physical Requirements:**


* Ability to lift 25 pounds
* Repeated use of sight to read documents and computer screens
* Repeated use of hearing and speech to communicate on telephone and in person
* Repetitive hand movements, such as keyboarding, writing, 10\-key
* Walking, bending, sitting, reaching and stretching in all directions


**Benefits \& Compensation:**


* Higginbotham offers medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, 401K, equity incentive plan as well as multiple supplemental benefits for physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing.
* Company paid holidays, plus PTO
* Employee wellness program


**Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies:** To protect the interests of all parties, Higginbotham Insurance Agency, Inc., and our partners, will not accept unsolicited potential placements from any source other than directly from the candidate or a vendor partner under MSA with Higginbotham. Please do not contact or send unsolicited potential placements to our team members.


* Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Welcome to Gordon Food Service! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. See below for a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you...


**Overview**
============

For over 125 years, Gordon Food Service has delivered the excellence, expertise, and quality products our customers need to design successful food operations and experiences. We've grown to be the largest family\-operated broadline food distribution company in North America by being passionately committed to the people we serve.  



  

At Gordon Food Service, our customers come first. As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you will cultivate relationships, develop new business, and provide innovative solutions to our customers, helping them to achieve their goals and, in return, yours!  



  

This position will reside in: **Marietta, GA.**

  

**Position Benefits**
=====================

* A generous 401(k) matching program that is above industry standards
* Financial rewards for performance compensation structure which includes salary, commission, and bonuses
* Low\-cost benefit options for you and your family's health and future
* An Automobile expense reimbursement plan
Cell phone reimbursement plan  
* 

  

**Outside Food Sales Representative**
=====================================

We invite you to join our sales team where you’ll experience a world where servant leadership and cutting\-edge tools and training come together to support your career growth and financial objectives.  



  

As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you’ll be responsible for the overall sales and relationship management efforts for existing and prospective customers within your assigned territory. This includes pursuing new customers, deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships, and sales territory management.  



  

**Pursuing New Customers**
--------------------------

* Researching industry and market trends impacting restaurants within your territory
* Identifying and researching prospective customers within your territory
Developing sales strategies that highlight products, services, values, and solutions offered by Gordon Food Service and presenting the sales strategy to prospective customers  
* 

  

**Deepen and Strengthen Existing Customer Relationships**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Visiting all customers within the assigned territory on a weekly, bi\-weekly, or monthly basis
* Conducting business reviews to determine existing customers needs and areas of opportunity for growing sales
* Providing ongoing training to customers on Gordon Food Service product offerings
Identifying opportunities within existing customers businesses where Gordon Food Service can add value through product and service offerings  
* 

  

**Sales Territory Management**

* Balancing new customers acquisition and deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships
* Coordinating visits to prospective customers and existing customers
Communicating order status and order processing updates to customers  
* 

  

**Sales Training \- Getting you Ready**
=======================================

Gordon Food Service’s goal during your first 90 days is to set you up for success! This includes engaging you in various training offerings, including e\-learning, classroom sessions, video roleplays, job shadowing, and peer sales representative mentorship. Throughout your first 90 days, you will learn:


* How to use Gordon Food Service systems, processes, and tools to manage customer relationships
* About the products available to Gordon Food Service customers
* The sales process for engaging new customers
* How to establish your relationships in the vast network of resources available to you, a Gordon Food Service sales representative
* Best practices on developing relationships with current and prospective customers
Strategies on how to effectively manage your territory  
* 

  

**Position Requirements**
=========================

* High School Diploma/GED is required
* Bachelor's degree and/or culinary certificate preferred
* 1 year of prior sales, business, or food service experience
* Maintaining a valid state driver's license and a safe driving record
Ability to obtain your food safety certification  
* 

  

Gordon Food Service encourages veterans and active military members to apply


**BE PART OF AN AMAZING CULTURE WHERE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU, MATTERS TO US!**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Gordon Food Service values our customers and understands that their success is largely dependent upon their workforce. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEAO
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY:**
================


The Low Income Investment Fund is a non\-profit Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) that mobilizes capital and partners to achieve opportunity, equity and wellbeing for people and communities. LIIF innovates financial solutions to create more equitable outcomes for all by building and preserving affordable homes, quality educational opportunities from early childhood through higher education, health clinics, healthy food retail and community facilities. In this way, LIIF provides a bridge between private capital markets and communities. LIIF’s headquarters is in San Francisco and has offices in Los Angeles, New York, Atlanta, and Washington D.C.**POSITION SUMMARY:**
=====================


The Executive Assistant provides administrative support to the Chief External Affairs Officer.**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:**
============================


The position reports to the CEAO**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**
========================


The Executive Assistant (EA) provides a broad variety of executive support in a one\-on\-one working relationship, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters pertaining to the Office of the CEAO. Assists in organizing and coordinating retreats, site visits and external relations efforts; supports the CEAO with all travel and expense management and completes special projects as assigned. The EA exercises good judgment and maintains confidentiality and discretion in a variety of situations.  

 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


 CEAO and General Executive Affairs Departmental Support

* Serves in “gatekeeper” role for internal and external constituencies, consulting with CEAO as needed and using discretion to determine appropriate course of action. Prioritizes conflicting needs while providing a bridge for smooth communication between the CEAO and internal departments; demonstrates leadership to maintain credibility, trust and support with LIIF staff.
* Working with both external and internal contacts, schedules and manages a calendar of calls, videoconferences and in\-person meetings. Maintains CEAO’s contacts in Outlook.
* Works closely and effectively with the CEAO to keep him/her well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Works with staff and external constituencies to obtain preparatory materials for CEAO’s review in advance of meetings.
* Attends virtual meetings at the request of the CEAO and takes notes that are distributed to attendees. Ensures that attendees follow up on tasks as assigned.
* Maintains tasks / deliverables in Asana of outstanding CEAO meetings, activities and deliverables.
* Arranges frequent travel, including plane, train and hotel reservations and conference registration. Schedules travel\-related meetings and obtains necessary preparatory materials in advance.
* Coordinates weekly External Affairs team meetings, soliciting agenda items and disseminating agendas and materials in advance of each meeting. Shares notes after meetings.
* Coordinates the completion of expense reports with receipts, in accordance with internal policies.
* Composes written and email correspondence on behalf of CEAO. Maintains electronic files and records. Completes mailings/shipping and obtain office supplies and equipment.
* Completes special projects at the request of the CEAO, which may involve research, analysis, document formatting and recommendations for a course of action. Create PowerPoint presentations as needed. Ability to use Lucid chart for workflows and visualization. Lead e\-signature via Nitro or other platforms to multiple authorized signatories. Maintain delegation hierarchy chart and update if needed.
* Assists in preparing annual department budgets for the Office of the CEAO. Monitors expenditures and reports variances to the CEAO.
* Initiates and executes contracts in Salesforce; coordinates payments to consultants and vendors as approved by CEAO.
* Provides occasional support for other members of the External Affairs team as assigned.
* Works under the supervision of the CEAO on board\-related matters. Coordinates with CEAO and other EA staff on the preparation of materials for all committees and board meetings.
* Coordinate with other EAs for preparing efficiently and on time regarding important meetings and events.
* Identifies ways to streamline company operations and practices for improved productivity and reduced duplication.
**QUALIFICATIONS:**
===================


Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment, with minimal supervision. Ability to adapt to and work effectively in evolving situations and to anticipate executive needs. Must possess a high standard for generating quality work and a positive attitude and demeanor. Must possess strong interpersonal skills and be capable of working both independently and seeking guidance from supervisors for priority setting. In addition, candidates will have advanced\-level skills with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint; proficiency with Excel and Zoom; and familiarity with databases such as Salesforce and expense management systems like Concur or Expensify. Will possess strong administrative and organizational skills; excellent communication skills, verbal and written; and research experience. The EA will be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment; and will be able to handle complex logistical arrangements.**EDUCATIONAL AND OTHER****REQUIREMENTS:**
==========================================


A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required. The candidate must have a minimum of two years of comparable experience supporting a C\-level executive. The position is demanding and requires excellent attendance, self\-motivation, attention to detail, thoroughness, creativity, and a high degree of flexibility. Travel may be required at least once each year, for 2\-3 days each trip. Individual

jobs.title: Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation \& Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate\-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root\-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  

About DO \& CO
  
  

We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges \& Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready\-to\-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic\-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre\-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow\-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready\-to\-eat and high\-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen\-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color\-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation\-related deficiencies.
* Review pest\-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste\-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared\-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool\-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non\-Halal cross\-contact.
* Lead sanitation\-related investigations and root\-cause analyses.
* Develop risk\-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long\-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross\-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow\-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third\-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Safety, Biology, Environmental Health, Public Health, Food Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least five years of progressive experience in food manufacturing, airline catering, commissary operations, sanitation, food safety, or quality assurance.
* Strong working knowledge of food sanitation, GMPs, HACCP, Environmental Monitoring Programs, sanitation verification, and preventive controls.
* Demonstrated experience conducting sanitation inspections, investigations, root\-cause analyses, and corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Experience identifying microbiological, sanitation, hygienic\-design, allergen, and cross\-contamination risks in complex food\-production environments.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

* Participate in creative projects with the marketing team.
* Coordinate with managers to maintain marketing and business development materials including databases, schedules, client management documents, and other support materials.
* Manage and update information in marketing databases.
* Provide miscellaneous marketing administrative support within the Marketing team and the firm as whole.
* Assist with other marketing pursuits, campaigns and awards as needs arise.

**Requirements**
* Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, English, History, Communications, or other related field.
* Strong reading comprehension skills with the ability to interpret complex instructional documents.
* 1\-3 years of experience in an AEC or other professional service firm.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong copywriting and editing skills.

**Personal Qualities, Other Skills/Abilities**
* Excellent writing skills with the ability to craft articulate text with a targeted purpose.
* Thoughtful communicator and problem solver who is eager to observe, listen, learn, collaborate, and lead proposals for a variety of building projects.
* Ability to manage assignments under deadline pressure and, when necessary to meet deadlines, be willing to work overtime.
* Flexibility and creativity in responding to clients and potential clients.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**  

Visual Comfort \& Co. is the premier resource for decorative and architectural lighting, ceiling fans, system controls and automated shading solutions from the most influential designers in the world. We are proud to offer a market\-leading range of premium products across categories, styles and price points, remaining committed to beautiful design and, above all, a world\-class customer experience.
  
  

This role is responsible for collaborating with the Experiential Marketing team and cross\-functional partners to execute marketing initiatives across 70\+ showroom markets. Duties include coordinating event logistics, developing marketing assets, supporting showroom teams with events and openings, and executing local marketing programs.
  
  

**Visual Comfort Offers:**  

* Work\-Life Balance: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm
* Training \& Development: A comprehensive and structured training program, complemented by ongoing education and opportunities for career advancement.
* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation accrual and paid time off policies.
* Holidays: 7 paid holidays per year, in addition to 2 floating holidays.
* Compensation: Competitive compensation plan
* Health Benefits: Visual Comfort covers the majority of employee medical premiums, and offers competitive vision and dental coverage available starting the first of the month following your start date.
* Insurance: Company\-provided life insurance and short\-term disability coverage.
* Retirement: 401(k) plan with company matching up to 4%, available beginning the first of the month following your hire date.


**How success is defined:**  

* Facilitate the planning and execution of showroom events, activations, new showroom openings, and experiential marketing initiatives across showroom markets.
* Coordinate event logistics, including timelines, vendors, permits, licensing, documentation, and deliverables to support successful execution.
* Manage event budgets, expenses, and invoices, including tracking and reconciliation, and support post\-event reporting and recaps.
* Administer and support event management platforms, including Splash, and maintain project trackers, calendars, timelines, and documentation.
* Develop and coordinate the production of marketing collateral, including print and digital invitations, signage, in\-store materials, email campaigns, landing pages, social media assets, and presentations.
* Coordinate the timely delivery of marketing assets with internal teams and external vendors while ensuring brand consistency, accuracy, and quality across all materials.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Marketing, Retail, showroom teams, and external partners to support showroom events, openings, and local marketing initiatives.
* Works effectively with others in a team environment to accomplish organizational goals and to identify and resolve problems.
* Exhibits and adheres to the established Visual Comfort Company Values.
* Must demonstrate commitment, dependability, punctuality, and adherence to agreed\-upon schedule while maintaining a consistent presence in the workplace to effectively collaborate and communicate amongst co\-workers and teams.


**What you will bring:**  

* 4 \- 7 years’ previous experience in marketing, event planning, project coordination, or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.
* Strong aptitude for and proficiency navigating systems and programs, including Microsoft 365; experience with SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite, and event management platforms preferred.
* Experience in luxury retail, interior design, home furnishings, and/or the design industry a plus.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with a strong attention to detail and demonstrated project management capabilities.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, deadlines, vendors, and changing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to achieve results both independently and through others by fostering a spirit of teamwork and cooperation.
* Demonstrates exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered for this role.


**Compensation Range:** $60,000 \- $65,000
  
  

Compensation is based on individual factors, including skill set, relevant experience, and work location

Qualified applicants are considered for employment, and employees are treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.
  
  

To be eligible for this role, you must be authorized to work in the United States. We do not offer any type of employment\-based immigration sponsorship for this role. Likewise, Visual Comfort \& Co., will not provide any assistance or sign any documentation in support of any other form of immigration sponsorship or benefit including optional practical training (OPT) or curricular practical training (CPT).

jobs.title: Account Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Business Account Sales Representative — Corporate Transportation

**O’Hare Limo Services \| Chicago, IL**

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Luxury Transportation / Ground Transportation  
**Experience Level:** Sales experience preferred, especially B2B, hospitality, transportation, travel, or account management

About O’Hare Limo Services

O’Hare Limo Services has been proudly serving Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs for **over 35 years**. Located on Foster Avenue near the Rosemont Fashion Outlet Mall, we specialize in professional, reliable transportation to and from **O’Hare International Airport**, as well as corporate and private transportation throughout the Chicago area.

We are looking for an ambitious, relationship\-focused **Business Account Sales Representative** to help expand our growing corporate client base.

This is an opportunity for a motivated sales professional who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, negotiating business agreements, and turning new clients into long\-term accounts.

The Opportunity

As a Business Account Sales Representative, your primary goal will be to **prospect, pitch, and secure corporate transportation accounts** that generate recurring business.

You will work directly with businesses, hotels, corporate travel managers, executive assistants, office managers, and other decision\-makers who regularly arrange transportation for employees, executives, clients, and guests.

The ideal candidate is comfortable making outbound calls, developing their own leads, conducting face\-to\-face or virtual sales meetings, negotiating customized corporate rates, and managing relationships after the sale.

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Development \& Lead Generation

* Proactively identify and prospect new corporate accounts throughout Chicago and the Chicagoland area.
* Conduct outbound sales calls, emails, networking, and in\-person outreach.
* Develop relationships with hotels, corporate offices, travel managers, executive assistants, event planners, and local businesses.
* Generate new business rather than relying solely on inbound quote requests.
* Research prospective companies and identify transportation needs and decision\-makers.
* Schedule and conduct sales presentations and account meetings.

Corporate Account Onboarding

* Present O’Hare Limo Services’ transportation solutions to prospective clients.
* Develop customized corporate rate sheets based on client transportation needs.
* Guide new accounts through the onboarding process.
* Assist corporate clients with establishing pre\-saved passenger and profile databases.
* Set up centralized billing and recurring account procedures.
* Coordinate account information and preferences with our operations team.
* Utilize transportation management and reservation platforms such as **Limo Anywhere**.

Account Management \& Retention

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned corporate accounts.
* Build long\-term relationships with travel coordinators, executive assistants, office managers, and other key contacts.
* Monitor account activity and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Follow up with clients to encourage repeat and recurring bookings.
* Resolve customer concerns professionally and coordinate with operations when necessary.
* Maintain accurate account information and sales activity.

Revenue Growth \& Upselling

* Introduce clients to our range of luxury transportation options, including:
* Luxury sedans
* SUVs
* Executive vans
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts.
* Encourage clients to consolidate transportation needs with O’Hare Limo Services.
* Develop recurring corporate transportation programs and preferred\-vendor relationships.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly motivated and results\-oriented.
* Comfortable with outbound prospecting and cold calling.
* Confident communicating with business owners and corporate decision\-makers.
* Professional, personable, and relationship\-focused.
* Organized and capable of managing multiple accounts and sales opportunities.
* Comfortable negotiating rates and business agreements.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Persistent without being overly aggressive.
* Comfortable using CRM, sales, email, and computer\-based systems.
* Experienced in B2B sales, account management, hospitality, transportation, travel, or a related industry is a plus.

**Previous limousine or transportation\-industry experience is helpful, but not required for the right sales professional.**

Compensation

**Competitive base compensation \+ commission/incentive structure**

Compensation will vary based on experience, sales performance, and the commission structure established for the position.

We are interested in speaking with experienced sales professionals who are motivated by the opportunity to build a substantial book of recurring corporate business.

Why Join O’Hare Limo Services?

* **35\+ years in business**
* Established Chicago\-area transportation company
* Strong focus on corporate and airport transportation
* Opportunity to develop long\-term B2B accounts
* Established luxury vehicle fleet
* Chicago and Chicagoland market
* Located conveniently on Foster Avenue near the Rosemont Fashion Outlet Mall
* Opportunity to build recurring revenue through corporate accounts
* Work with businesses, hotels, executives, travel professionals, and other established organizations

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

This position is particularly well suited for a salesperson who understands that **the sale doesn't end when the contract is signed**.

Successful candidates will enjoy developing relationships, staying in touch with clients, finding new opportunities within existing accounts, and building a pipeline of recurring corporate transportation business.

If you are a motivated B2B salesperson who wants to build relationships and grow a book of corporate accounts with an establi

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company**  

Coesia is a group of innovation\-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Coesia has operating units in 36 countries, a turnover of 2,015 million euros in 2022 and over 8,000 employees. Coesia, a group of innovation\-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy, and fully owned by Isabella Seràgnoli. Coesia's companies are leaders in automation solutions for multiple industries, ranging from automated processing and packaging machinery, testing and vision systems, to digital printing technologies, factory flow solutions and precision gears. Our customers include leading players in Consumer Goods, Healthcare \& Pharma, Tobacco, Ceramic Tiles, Luxury Goods, Aerospace, Racing \& Automotive, Electronics. Coesia has 141 operating units in 35 countries, a turnover of about 1\.9 billion euros and over 8,000 employees. In the United States, Coesia employs over 900 people.

 **About the Role**  

The Sales Account Manager will be responsible for managing all sales activities for current and future customers specific to the assigned equipment portfolio. Position reports to the Coesia North America Customer Service Sales Director for CMS. The Sales Account Manager will provide leadership and management directions for the product line. Also responsible for developing a comprehensive sales and marketing strategy that grows the product line in terms of size and profitability.


* Lead sales and strategic direction for the assigned equipment technology and aftermarket product lines, driving revenue growth and market expansion.
* Serve as the primary technical expert and trusted advisor for packaging equipment, aftermarket services, and modernization solutions.
* Develop and execute strategic sales plans, forecasts, budgets, and targeted campaigns to increase equipment, parts, service, and sales training.
* Identify, qualify, and close opportunities for capital equipment, spare parts, rebuilds, upgrades, conversions, audits, service agreements, and training programs.
* Analyze customer operations, market trends, competitive activity, and growth opportunities to maximize sales performance and profitability.
* Build and maintain executive\-level customer relationships through consultative, solution\-oriented selling and asset management strategies.
* Ensure customers receive complete lifecycle solutions, including new machinery, aftermarket support, modernization, service, parts, and training.
* Prospect, penetrate, and grow assigned accounts while developing strategic plans for key customers and regions.
* Prepare and coordinate quotations, proposals, and technical solutions in collaboration with engineering, service, operations, and marketing teams.
* Clearly define and communicate customer requirements to ensure accurate proposals and successful project execution.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, customer contracts, and agent agreements to secure profitable business outcomes.
* Manage all commercial aspects of customer orders, including order acknowledgments, issue resolution, invoicing, change management, and payment collection.
* Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline visibility, and business reports covering revenue, pricing, competitive intelligence, wins, losses, and market trends.
* Lead aftermarket sales campaigns and collaborate with marketing to develop and execute machine\-specific promotional programs.
* Establish, track, and drive sales objectives and performance metrics to ensure attainment of growth targets.
* Represent the company at industry trade shows, customer events, and market development activities.
* Partner with senior leadership on annual budget development, business planning, and strategic initiatives.
* Monitor and assess competitor activity, market conditions, and industry trends to support strategic decision\-making.
* Maintain accurate customer contacts, sales activities, opportunities, communications, forecasts, and account information within Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
* Travel extensively to customer facilities to strengthen relationships, identify business opportunities, and support customer success.

 **What You Need to Be Successful**  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferably with an emphasis on technical selling. Experience with strategic sales action planning.
* Experience with strategic sales planning, business development, and account management.
* Budgeting, sales forecasting, and pipeline management experience.
* Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding aggressive sales growth targets and business objectives.
* Technical knowledge of packaging equipment, cartoning systems, or related manufacturing industries; food packaging experience preferred but not required.
* Experience utilizing CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics for opportunity management, forecasting, and customer relationship management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Understanding commercial terms, contracts, pricing, and customer agreements.
* Experience managing complex customer projects and coordinating cross\-functional resources.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally, with travel requirements of 50% 75%.

  

**Our Offer**  

Coesia North America offers a competitive benefit package which includes, among other things:

jobs.description:
**Client Relations Associate**
Our client is a growing financial services firm in the Oakbrook Terrace, IL area that is looking for a professional, organized, and client\-focused Client Relations Associate to join their team.
This is a highly visible role where you will serve as one of the first points of contact for clients, prospects, and callers. You’ll be responsible for creating a warm, professional experience from the first interaction while helping manage a high volume of calls, coordinate communication, support the front desk, and keep the office running smoothly.
For someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience, this is an opportunity to join a professional organization with training, development, and opportunities for growth.
**Why This Opportunity Stands Out**
Our client places a strong emphasis on creating an outstanding client experience. This position is not simply about answering phones — you will play an important role in how clients and prospects experience the firm.
You’ll be trusted to manage incoming calls, help clients with questions, coordinate appointments, maintain accurate records, and ensure messages and follow\-up items get to the right people. You’ll also serve as a backup to the front desk, greeting clients and guests when they arrive at the office.
The ideal person will bring a warm, welcoming personality, exceptional phone skills, strong organization, and a genuine desire to help people.

Our client is looking for someone who is professional, personable, organized, and comfortable working in a time\-sensitive, high\-volume environment. The ideal candidate enjoys interacting with people and can maintain a high level of service even when priorities are changing quickly.

* Routing calls to the appropriate person or department and taking accurate messages when necessary.
* Providing exceptional customer service and assisting callers with questions or needs.

* Maintaining detailed and accurate records of incoming calls, messages, and outcomes.

* Providing administrative support to various departments, including data entry, filing, scanning, photocopying, and other general office tasks.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time\-sensitive environment.
* Ability to adapt to changes without compromising the quality of work.
* Experience with calendar and CRM management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new software quickly.
* Comfortable working with phone systems, filing, faxing, scanners, and general office technology.
* Professional appearance and demeanor.
* Hospitality, concierge, or client service experience is preferred but not required.

* Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.

* Can juggle multiple priorities without losing track of important details.
* Enjoys being part of a team and supporting those around them.
* Has a hospitality, concierge, client service, or customer\-facing background.
* Wants to join an organization that provides training, professional development, and opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Marketing & Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing\-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world\-class brands, including Abaque®, All\-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em\-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state\-of\-the\-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO\-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps \& Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.


We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close\-to\-the\-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly \& fast paced environment.


PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.


**Position Summary:**

The Marketing \& Social Media Manager role is primarily focused on social media strategy planning, content creation, posting, and social listening and response. This hands\-on marketing position is responsible for the development and implementation of marketing communications strategies that are aligned with PSG’s objectives and goals for all PSG brands. Marketing strategies and tactics will be focused on improving our customer experience, growing our business, increasing awareness, generating leads, and supporting other business objectives as assigned. The Marketing \& Social Media Manager will be responsible for the creation, development, and management of content, and social media posts, to ensure alignment with our commercial strategies and brand standards.


This role will engage with internal stakeholders (multiple facilities and disciplines such as marketing, product management, engineering, sales, business development, legal, IT, and executive management) and external stakeholders (marketing agencies, tradeshow and event hosts, consultants, customers, partners, buying influences, etc...). * Strategize and Plan (tied to overall company strategy and business objectives)

	+ Share assets that resonate with target audience (e.g. White paper, case study, photos…)
* Post in accordance with calendar, or repost as needed
* Social Listening and response

* Others communication duties as assigned: e.g. blogs, press releases, corporate communications
* Collaborate with Marketing Managers, Product Managers, Engineers, Legal, Dover Corporate, Agency

* Create and adhere to brand standards, templates, and standard work

* Execute External \& Internal communications

All other duties assigned
