Each of CenExel’s research sites specialize in Phase I to Phase IV clinical trials. Our Centers of Excellence comprise some of the most well respected and long\-standing research facilities in the country. Specialty areas of research across our sites include Psychiatry, Acute Post Op Pain, Asian Bridging, Dermatology, GI, and Neurology. Each of our Centers of Excellence has tremendous experience and expertise in complex early phase trials, and all our sites have in\-patient capability. We focus on quality people, teamwork, and highly experienced clinical research managers with a history of success.



Along with an exceptional work environment that promotes teamwork, positive leadership, and optimal work\-life balance, CenExel Clinical Research also provides highly competitive compensation and a generous benefits package to full time employees after 30 days of employment including Health Insurance, Dental, Vision, LTD, STD, Life Ins, and 401k.


**Schedule: Monday \- Friday (08:00 am \- 4:30 pm)**


**Hourly Range: $30\.00 \- $33\.00** **(Depending on education, experience, and skillset)**


**Job Summary:**

Responsible for assisting with coordinating clinical trials with the strictest adherence to ICH (International Conference on Harmonization), GCP (Good Clinical Practices), protocol, and company guidelines, regulations, and policies.


**Essential Responsibilities and Duties:**


* Assists with coordinating all aspects of patient involvement from study initiation until study completion.
* Organizes research information for clinical trials.
* Observes subjects and assists with data analysis and reporting.
* Schedules the collection of data.
* Documents adverse events, protocol deviations, and other unanticipated problems appropriately.
* Reports research data to maintain quality and compliance.
* Performs administrative and regulatory duties related to the study as appropriate.
* Participates in other protocol development activities.
* Ensures site receives accurate information and supplies from sponsors (i.e.: source, protocol, scales, supplies, approvals, contacts, etc.)
* Educates potential participants and caregivers on protocol specific details and expectations.
* Performs safety and efficacy assessments per protocol (vital signs, EKGs, blood draws and other assessments as assigned).
* Assumes other duties and responsibilities as assigned. The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and are not to be considered as all inclusive.


**Education/Experience/Skills:**


* High school graduate or equivalent; Bachelor's Degree, preferred.
* **1\+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Coordinator (Required)**
* **Phlebotomy** **Experience (Highly Desired)**
* Knowledge and understanding of Federal regulations protecting human subjects in research and that govern the conduct of clinical trials.
* Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
* Developing and maintaining effective working relationships at all levels of the organization, along with those at the sponsor and vendor level.
* Crisis management and problem\-solving skills; ability to react calmly and effectively in emergent situations.
* Works independently as well as functioning as part of a team.
* Must be able to effectively communicate verbally and in writing.

* Indoor, Office environment.


* Shift work, depending on location.


* Essential physical requirements include sitting, typing, standing, and walking.


* Lightly active position, occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds. Rarely lift over 20 pounds.

As a Commercial Account Manager at Nutanix in Southern California, you will have the opportunity to sell our cutting\-edge products and solutions to Commercial customers in the market. **What You Will Bring*** 8\+ Years experience with a track record of exceeding assigned sales quotas in multiple, continuous years.
* You are someone with an entrepreneurial spirit with an affinity for collaboration and teamwork.

* You are extremely organized, with deep knowledge of territory planning and strategy.
* You have an aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems as well as the competitive landscape.

**Work Arrangement****Remote**: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in\-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.

If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. ### **Position**

JOB TITLE: Operations Associate


**REPORTS TO:** Operations Manager


**JOB PURPOSE**

The Operations Associate is responsible for maintaining the store’s inventory and stock areas as per Company standards, minimizing stock loss, maintaining organized records, ordering supplies, adhering to housekeeping standards, handling merchandise appropriately, controlling expenses, and safeguarding company assets by following proper inventory control procedures.


### **Job responsibilities**

**TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Ensure that all shipping and receiving functions that affect the store inventory are processed accurately and efficiently
* Maintain an orderly and neat stock and receiving area as well as the general maintenance of the store, ensuring merchandise is properly ticketed and sensored
* Ensure the accurate processing of all inbound freight, returns\-to\-vendors (RTV's), chargebacks, transfers and damages based on Company policies and procedures
* Support the compliance of receiving practices with established Company policies and standards, such as safekeeping of Company funds and property, personnel practices, security, and record\-keeping procedures.
* Ensure that the stock is appropriately security tagged to prevent loss
* Communicate with central distribution and/or the corporate inventory control department.
* Participate in all inventory and cycle counts
* Assist in floor moves, merchandising, display maintenance, and housekeeping
* Assist in completing price changes within the boutique
* Assist in packing or wrapping customers’ merchandise, when necessary
* Help solve problems and make informed suggestions that affect the service, and productivity of the receiving area
* Comply with all company policies and procedures
* Participate in store meetings and training seminars as necessary
* Any other tasks as assigned from time to time by any manager
### **Profile**

**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

* Ability to handle receiving operations effectively, including proper handling of merchandise
* Strong interpersonal, communication, organization and follow\-through skills

new_jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, US HPP, San Francisco, CA
new_jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco, United States Job reference: R\-260716 Date posted: 09/28/2026
**Regional Account Manager, US HPP, San Francisco, CA**


**This is what you will do:**


Professionally represent Alexion in educating HPP disease customers and identifying patients impacted by HPP and ensure high levels of visibility to Alexion’s disease awareness initiatives and a high degree of customer satisfaction in territory. Implement sales/marketing disease, diagnostic and branded programs. Maintain effective communication and relationships with key external and internal customers.


**You will be responsible for:**


* Consistently achieving or exceeding sales objectives in assigned territory
* Developing and maintaining in\-depth knowledge of the product, market, and customers
* Developing and implementing strategically targeted account\-specific territory business plans in line with corporate strategy that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales.
* Managing territory, analyzing the market dynamics to ensure territory sales goals are met, and updating business plans to reflect knowledge.
* Developing and maintaining strong in\-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge
* Seeking out and qualifying leads and profile new accounts
* Educating on the diagnostic approach to the disease leading to a successful differential diagnosis and appropriate testing of patient populations
* Appropriately utilizing marketing tools and resources including power point presentations
* Leading the implementation of our patient\-centric partnership model in assigned territory which will include physicians, their staff, , clinics, and hospitals and provide high level product expertise and customer service to all accounts
* Making compelling and persuasive sales calls to designated customers resulting in sales of Alexion products.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders, including: TLL(s), SAL(s), MSL(s), FRM(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, andother respective Enterprise partners
* Proactively interacting with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives
* Effectively and efficiently managing time, priorities, CRM tool, resources, and workload
* Managing administrative responsibilities, submit reports on sales activities accurately and on\-time
* Performing work in alignment with and adheres to all Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.

**You will need to have:**


* Degree in life science and/or business/marketing
* Proven, documented track record for delivering consistent ‘Top\-tier’ sales results demonstrate a consistent track record of success (Top 20% performance).
* Minimum 5 years Pharmaceutical or Equivalent Experience (e.g. Biotech or Medical Device)
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment, on a consistent basis
* Ability to gain consistent access \& develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in community and academic centers
* Demonstrated strategic territory management successes
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and organizational abilities
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving
* Ability to travel (minimum 50\-60%) within assigned territory on a regular basis which will include frequent overnight and some weekend travel.
* The duties of this role are generally conducted in a field environment. As is typical of a field\-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: travel by public transportation, automobile, train, or plane; work comfortably in a clinical setting; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non\-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours.

**We would prefer for you to have:**


* Advanced or master’s degree preferred
* Biopharma Experience
* Top tier awards preferred i.e. President’s Club Award.
* Strong preference for sales experience in one or more of following:
	+ Endocrinology and Medical Genetics specialties and/or experience selling to physicians specialized in treating bone disorders
	+ Enzyme Replacement Therapy products
	+ Orphan, Ultra\-Orphan or rare disease experience
	+ Nephrology, Orthopedic surgery and Rheumatology specialties
	+ Self\-injected product
	+ Institution/academic center account experience is preferred

*The annual base pay for this position ranges from $152,636 \- $228,954\. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans*


**Date Posted**


28\-Sep\-2026
**Closing Date**


26\-Nov\-2026
Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

At Doppel, partnerships are a critical growth engine. We believe the best channel relationships are built on trust, transparency, and mutual success \- not just transactions. Our partners are an extension of our sales team, and when they win, we win.



We're looking for a Channel Account Manager to accelerate Doppel's Channel Strategy in the NorCal/Northwest team. * Develop joint business plans to drive pipeline and revenue growth through partners.

* Collaborate closely with Enterprise and Mid\-Market sellers to co\-sell and accelerate deals.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Help more engineering teams find and adopt cloud mobile development. Limrun gives cloud agents the infrastructure they need to build, run, test, and ship iOS and Android apps. We're hiring an SDR to find the right companies, start informed conversations, and create qualified opportunities for our sales team.


**Why Limrun**
--------------



Limrun is building a new category, so the SDR work goes beyond running a fixed sequence against a purchased list. You'll work directly with the founder and early GTM team to decide which accounts matter, learn what earns a response from technical buyers, and turn those lessons into a repeatable outbound motion.



Limrun is already in production at platforms like Replit, Rork, Minitap, Momentic. We are backed by investors including CRV, Y Combinator, and Eniac Ventures.



As an early sales hire, your work will be visible in the pipeline and the product conversations that follow. There is room to take on broader sales responsibility as you learn the product and show consistent judgment.


**The role**
------------



You'll own the top of the funnel. That means researching accounts and contacts, reaching out with relevant messages, qualifying initial interest, and arranging meetings with enough context for an Account Executive or founder to take the opportunity forward. The quality of the handoff matters more than raw activity.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Build target\-account lists across AI app\-building platforms, mobile engineering organizations adopting cloud agents, internal developer\-platform teams, and testing or QA companies.
* Find the people closest to the problem, including engineering executives, developer\-experience and platform leaders, mobile engineering leaders, and senior technical champions.
* Research each account and write outreach based on its mobile products, agent initiatives, infrastructure needs, and likely buying triggers.
* Run outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone, warm introductions, and other channels that you test and measure.
* Respond quickly to inbound interest and qualify the use case, urgency, technical context, stakeholders, and next step.
* Book qualified meetings and give the Account Executive or founder a clear handoff: who is involved, what problem they are trying to solve, why it matters now, and what was agreed.
* Keep Salesforce accurate and maintain disciplined follow\-up. Document outreach experiments, account progress, and results so the team can learn from them.
* Learn Limrun well enough to explain the product accurately to technical buyers and avoid promising capabilities that are not available.

**How you'll use AI and automation**
------------------------------------



You'll help build the workflows behind the outbound work as well as run them. Use AI and practical automation to improve research, data quality, and follow\-up, with human review of the facts and messages.


* Build repeatable account\-research and contact\-enrichment workflows. Check information across sources, remove duplicates, and verify contact details before outreach.
* Monitor public buying signals such as relevant hiring, team changes, developer discussions, and product announcements. Record the source and explain why the signal makes an account worth contacting now.
* Write and test targeted outreach sequences, and set up the workflows that keep follow\-up timely. Adjust them based on replies and prospect activity; check AI\-generated claims and personalization before sending.
* Work with the founder and engineering team on email\-delivery checks and small messaging or landing\-page experiments. Use approved tools and respect opt\-outs and platform rules.
* Connect outreach sources and experiments to qualified meetings and opportunities in Salesforce. Use results and patterns in won customers to improve account selection, rather than judging success by send volume alone.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* You've personally created pipeline through outbound prospecting, ideally for an early\-stage technology company or a product that did not have an established brand.
* You can write short, specific outreach and speak confidently with technical prospects.
* You are curious enough to learn a developer product, understand a prospect's workflow, and ask useful follow\-up questions.
* You take ownership, ask for feedback, and are willing to do hands\-on research, prospecting, calling, and follow\-up every day.
* You are organized about CRM records, next steps, and follow\-through.
* You care about qualified meetings and real buying signals, not activity counts that do not turn into opportunities.


We care more about what you personally tried, learned, and produced than about titles or years of experience.


**Nice to have, not required**
------------------------------


* Experience selling developer tools, cloud infrastructure, AI development products, or another technical product.
* Experience prospecting to CTOs, engineering leaders, developer\-experience teams, platform teams, or mobile engineering organizations.
* Experience working in a startup where pipeline had to be created without a large marketing team.
* Familiarity with Salesforce and modern account\-research or outbound tools.

**What we offer**
-----------------


* Ownership of the outbound and qualification process at an early stage.
* Direct collaboration with the founder, the early GTM team, and the engineers building the product.
* A San Francisco office in South Park, with relocation support.
* Regular team offsites.

**Apply**
---------



Send us your resume or LinkedIn profile. In 4\-6 sentences, describe one outbound campaign or prospecting motion you personally ran. How did you choose the accounts, which channels and messages did you use, how did you qualify interest, and what was the outcome? Please do not include confidential customer information.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Account Manager - US Hub
new_jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Account Manager – US Hub**



Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?



The Inside Sales Account Manager (ISAM) is the primary sales representative responsible for the achievement of sales objectives and growth targets for our mid market and small medium enterprise customers. Territory includes exciting opportunities to grow smaller existing customers and establish new customers.



As an Inside Sales Account Manager dedicated to Siemens Digital Industries, you will work closely with our business to business customers, leveraging our field sales and distribution partners, to provide innovative and environmentally friendly solutions through our digital channels. You play an important part contributing to overall customer happiness and achieving annual sales growth aspirations.


**We are looking for an Inside Sales Account Manager. This position will have hybrid remote capability and will be based in Alpharetta, GA.**


***You’ll make an impact by:***


* Virtual selling is not just a buzzword for you: You target a balanced blend of engagement (e.g. Digital selling, virtual communication) with customers via digital enabled actions to ensure outstanding customer experience.
* Understanding customer needs and guiding decision making towards Siemens Solutions through compelling storytelling today and tomorrow.
* You have a passion for technology, products, and services within the area of industrial automation, and digitalization, understanding their value and the ability to help customers get the most out of our portfolio. (e.g., HMI, SINAMICS, SIMATIC).
* Thanks to your reliable consulting and proactive nature, you represent yourself at eye level for your customers and show the ability and confidence to work through tough situations if they arise.
* Personally, you capitalize with excellent listening skills and an honest, open communication style which generates excitement over the phone or in video calls.
* Ensure positive customer experiences by embracing a vast Siemens Ecosystem including: Field Sales, Product Marketing, the Distributor Sales Team etc. Success in this role will include collaborating with and leveraging partnership with US distribution channels and external industry associations/partner organizations.
* Use various tools (e.g., Salesforce CRM and Outreach) to manage, monitor and track opportunities on a timely basis, as well as document \& research customer information.
* Achieve and exceed personal sales targets.
* Find incremental business opportunities and drive closure within the targeted prospect and customer account base.


**You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:**



Basic Qualifications:


* 5\+ years of relevant professional experience
* 2\+ years of experience selling to business to business customers
* Sales training, including handling.
* Must have firsthand training and/or experience with CRM systems.
* Ability to generate prospective customers via warm and cold calling as assigned, as well as determined focus on follow up with decision makers and forward movement throughout the sales cycle.
* Ability to understand and interpret technical requirements for specific solutions being sold.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.


Preferred Qualifications:


* Bachelor’s Degree or equal professional work experience.
* Industrial background in Technology sales
* Prior experience using Salesforce as a CRM


**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs**


**About Siemens:**



We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.


**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**



We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. Learn more about our commitment to DEI here.



Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens. They are an integral part of our Business Conduct Guidelines and our corporate strategy.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks, and other opportunities at Eulerity.  ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


 CEAO and General Executive Affairs Departmental Support

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation \& Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate\-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root\-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  

About DO \& CO
  
  

We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges \& Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready\-to\-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic\-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre\-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow\-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready\-to\-eat and high\-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen\-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color\-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation\-related deficiencies.
* Review pest\-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste\-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared\-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool\-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non\-Halal cross\-contact.
* Lead sanitation\-related investigations and root\-cause analyses.
* Develop risk\-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long\-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross\-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow\-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third\-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Safety, Biology, Environmental Health, Public Health, Food Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least five years of progressive experience in food manufacturing, airline catering, commissary operations, sanitation, food safety, or quality assurance.
* Strong working knowledge of food sanitation, GMPs, HACCP, Environmental Monitoring Programs, sanitation verification, and preventive controls.
* Demonstrated experience conducting sanitation inspections, investigations, root\-cause analyses, and corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Experience identifying microbiological, sanitation, hygienic\-design, allergen, and cross\-contamination risks in complex food\-production environments.

new_jobs.title: Corporate Paralegal & Executive Assistant to the General Counsel
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Hilco Global, a subsidiary of ORIX Corporation USA, is a diversified financial services company that delivers integrated professional services and capital solutions that help clients maximize value and drive performance across the retail, commercial and industrial, real estate, manufacturing, brand and intellectual property sectors, and more. Hilco Global provides a range of customized solutions to healthy, stressed, and distressed companies to resolve complex situations and enhance long\-term enterprise value. Hilco Global works to deliver the best possible result by aligning interests with clients and providing strategic advice and, in many instances, the capital required to complete the deal. Hilco Global is based in Northbrook, Illinois and has more than 850 professionals operating on four continents. Visit www.hilcoglobal.com .


**Position Summary**

Hilco Global Professional Services, LLC is seeking a Corporate Paralegal \& Executive Assistant to the General Counsel to join its Legal Department at its office located at 5 Revere Drive, Suite 206, Northbrook, IL 60062\.


**Responsibilities:**

* Draft, review, edit and negotiate agreements and contracts, including non\-disclosure agreements and service agreements.
* Liaise with outside counsel, Hilco’s business units operating companies, registered agents and service providers, coordinate information and documents.
* Analyze and provide summaries of legal documents.
* Ensure compliance with state and federal laws, including formations, dissolutions, foreign qualifications, amendments, and domestications.
* Manage corporate records and filings, including drafting and reviewing limited liability company agreements, corporate resolutions, written consents, Secretary’s Certificates, and Incumbency Certificates.
* Work with entity management platforms (CSC EM, GEMS).
* Support internal corporate governance, produce extensive corporate charts in Visio and PowerPoint.
* Assist with mergers and acquisitions projects.
* Analyze founding documents (LLC agreements, corporate resolutions) to ensure compliance with their provisions.
* Conduct research on legal issues, regulations, and compliance matters to support corporate actions.
* Perform compliance duties, such as KYC process for new counterparties in World Check, Aspirent.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings and calls, prepare and distribute materials, agendas, pre\-reads, manage reminders.
* Screen and prioritize incoming messages; draft, edit, or route emails on behalf of the General Counsel.
* Keep and maintain document management systems.
* Prepare, edit, and proofread executive communications, reports, presentations, and documents using MS Office, Adobe, and AI tools.
* Draft, review, and send executive\-level emails, letters, and memos.
* Organize travel arrangements and manage executive expense reports.
* Assist in tracking and managing executive budgets by overseeing invoices and payments, and identifying discrepancies.
* Collaborate with finance teams to ensure alignment between departments.
* Track project metrics, organize project files (both physical and digital), and conduct research.
* Ensure office supplies, equipment, and IT services are available and functioning.
* Act as a liaison with office managers and IT support to troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, including clients, board members, and business partners.
* Provide backup support to team members and assist with various ad\-hoc projects to ensure seamless operations across departments.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent in Paralegal Studies, Political Science, or a related field, plus 10 years of experience as a corporate paralegal or related occupation.
* Performing review and revisions of nondisclosure agreements, contracts, and limited liability company agreements.
* Preparing various corporate governance documents; tracking and coordinating filings with regulatory agencies; managing registered agent communications; handing annual report filings; filing entity formations, amendments, foreign\-state qualifications, trade name registrations, withdrawals, apostilles/legalizations, and cancellations.
* Responding to Know Your Customer (KYC) and Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) information requests.
* Responding to SOPs and subpoenas, including running internal email searches for document requests.
* Performing conflict checks and assisting with drafting disclosure schedules for bankruptcy court filings.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

The position offers an annual base salary of $84,053 , along with eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus . Comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; life insurance; short\-term and long\-term disability coverage; voluntary critical illness and accident insurance; Medicare support; childcare benefits; paid time off (PTO); professional development reimbursement; and access to a company wellness program.


Hilco Global is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified candidates will be considered on merits and without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, gender, veteran, or disability status.


Hilco Global strives to comply with all applicable local/state regulations regarding displaying salary ranges. Any offered salary is determined based on relevant factors such as applicant's skills, job responsibilities, prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications and market considerations. In addition, Hilco Global is proud to offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, with options designed to help you make the best decisions for yourself, your family, and your lifestyle. Available benefits are based on eligibility. Our Total Rewards package includes a variety of medical and dental plans, vision coverage, disability and life insurance,
